story_overview: In a tense legal drama, lawyers Marcus and Arthur navigate a high-stakes case. Judge Nora presides over the courtroom where Marcus delivers a passionate argument from the lectern, as fellow judge Julian listens from the bench. Outside the courtroom, Arthur, Nora, and Priya engage in urgent conversations, suggesting the drama extends far beyond the courtroom walls.
